targets.title: A field experiment to estimate the effects of anchoring and framing on residents’ willingness to purchase water runoff management technologies
targets.evidence_quote: In the original field experiment that we replicate for this paper, Li, Fooks et al. (2021) reported that raising the anchor from the lowest value to the highest increased WTP for several products by 31%.
targets.outcome_quote: Our replication results reject the size of the original estimated effects. We find an estimated effect of 3.4% (95% CI [−3.4%, 10%]).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly reject the original effect magnitude and report insignificant effects; this is a rejection, not merely a smaller effect judged supported. Other anchoring experiments are literature context or power simulations, not separately re-tested findings.

reasoning: 621 new participants re-test the previously published HomeVISE field experiment. Re-use of older datasets to simulate power does not add replication targets.
